scientific_integrity: The infinite proof is by exact degree deficits, a bijective minimum-length source-to-sink routing, and a transfer matrix. Computations are supporting finite checks only.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic covers may repeat and may use forbidden factors; required windows are linearly rather than periodically admissible. Only the single forbidden binary triple 010 and its complement 101 are covered, for length at least three. The result has same-model rather than independent review.
title: Exact shortest cyclic covers of binary words avoiding the palindromic triple
